_comment: Business-unit to model entitlement matrix.
An Application Inference Profile wraps exactly one model, so per-BU cost
attribution across several models needs one profile per (team, model) pair.
This file is the single declarative source for that matrix: scripts/create-aips.sh
creates the profiles and scripts/create-team-config-table.sh seeds them into the
ai-gateway-team-config DynamoDB table.
profileName is explicit rather than derived. Profile names allow only
alphanumerics separated by single spaces, underscores or dashes (no dots or
colons), so a name cannot be mechanically generated from a model id without
lossy rewriting. Naming them here also lets existing profiles keep their names,
which matters because the CloudWatch dashboard references their ids.
models is an allow-list. A business unit requesting a model that is not listed
for it is denied, so entitlement and attribution are configured in one place.
defaultModel is used when a caller does not name a model (the agent plane
usually does not).
modelPricing drives the estimated-cost widgets on the CloudWatch dashboard.
CloudWatch has no notion of token price, so cost is computed as metric math over
token counts. Rates are US on-demand USD per 1M tokens and must be updated by hand
when AWS changes them. These are estimates for real-time visibility; Cost Explorer
remains the billing source of truth.
